providerEligibilityReview.scope: Provider review status only, independent of receiving-course equivalencies, exact degree placement, source recommendation periods and an individual student credit award. Provider review status establishes neither student enrollment permission nor a prohibition.

groups.title: B.S. in General Management area of study

rulesNotes: 45 general education + 42 Professional Business Requirements + 18 area of study + 15 free electives = 120 semester credits.
The two selected Human Cultures choices are HIS-1140 and PHI-1300. Scientific category alternatives require independently published classification, not a course-title similarity.
The catalog label identifies the same receiving catalog as the existing exact course awards. This exact degree’s primary body, capture hash and November 26 review date are recorded separately.
The standard nonmilitary 15-credit eligible-course residency and 90-credit combined noncollegiate cap remain distinct. Cornerstone and capstone are taken at TESU.
At least half of the business area of study must be current within ten years of the most recent application date; the business capstone has a five-year currency limit.

The selected area contains two Management, two Finance and two Marketing courses, satisfying the published minimum of three of the four permitted business areas. All 18 selected area credits are upper level.
ACC-4010 and ACC-2010 are not selected in this route. The five elective slots remain unrestricted; no prerequisite is removed from a course that remains selected.
MAN-3110 may count once, in the area of study. Its original outside course cannot also fill a free elective. MAN-3310 follows the already required MAN-2100 business-core course.

unresolved.message: Have TESU apply your enrollment catalog and evaluate any previous coursework.
If you use military benefits or Edison Accelerate, select the residency route that applies to you.

pricingNotes: Tuition comparisons use the separately dated published TESU tuition source. Books, provider checkout taxes and individual fees are separate from course-credit eligibility.

tuitionComparison.reviewScope: The exact current degree identity is bound to the retained standard undergraduate tuition comparison. The November 25 price-source review and amounts are unchanged; no new price review is claimed.
